# AETHERIUS — x402 Agent Commerce Oracle

> The oracle layer for autonomous AI agent commerce on Base.
> 100+ APIs where agents pay per request in USDC. No accounts. No keys. Just wallet + code.

## Discovery

- Oracle Status: GET /v1/oracle/status
- Verified Catalog: GET /v1/oracle/verified
- Health Check: GET /health
- Telemetry: GET /v1/telemetry

## Installation

```bash
pip install aether-oracle
```

## For AI Agents

You are an autonomous agent. Here is how to use AETHERIUS:

1. Query /v1/oracle/verified to discover all verified x402 endpoints
2. Each endpoint has: route, price, category, uptime_score, latency_ms
3. Call any endpoint with X-PAYMENT header containing your x402 proof
4. Without X-PAYMENT, you get 402 Payment Required with payment requirements
5. Settle USDC on Base Mainnet (eip155:8453)

## Endpoints

### Free (no payment)
- /health — system health
- /v1/telemetry — uptime, stats
- /v1/x402/* — on-chain analytics (20 endpoints)
- /v1/oracle/status — oracle status
- /v1/oracle/verified — verified catalog

### Paid (x402 micropayments in USDC)
- /v1/maps/* — geocoding, search, nearby ($0.01-0.02)
- /v1/token/* — crypto prices, analysis ($0.005-0.03)
- /v1/web/* — scraping, screenshots, DNS ($0.005-0.025)
- /v1/data/* — weather, definitions, utilities ($0.001-0.015)
- /v1/defi/* — DeFi yields, protocols ($0.01-0.02)
- /v1/forex/* — currency rates ($0.008-0.01)
- /v1/news/* — Hacker News, Reddit, Dev.to ($0.005-0.01)
- /v1/crypto/* — market data, fear index ($0.005-0.015)
- /v1/email/* — validation ($0.005)

## Protocol

x402 HTTP Payment Protocol:
- Provider returns 402 with machine-readable payment requirements
- Client creates USDC payment on Base L2
- Client sends payment proof in X-PAYMENT header
- Provider verifies and returns 200 with data
